reviewSummary: The subject is the frozen D-351 draft at the expected digest and mode. It records leftover-join.v28 of G21 as the G21 leftover remasurement after D-350 on independent dual Stage A ACCEPT 0/0, and it does so without closing anything. Every digest it prints matches live bytes; every live token it recites (last heading D-350, required-now 28, DR-G21 OPEN, DR-118 DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED, DR-107 PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW, DR-102 SATISFIED, condition 2 at 5 of 32, condition 4 MET on the naming half at 28 of 28, condition 5 last) matches the live register. Both Stage A return shapes are reproduced member by member, including absent fields and numeric counts, and neither is flattened to a decision field. The three historical landings the prompt protects (v27 to v28, v26 to v27, v24 to v25) are stated as the prompt states them and none is rewritten. All nine protected identifiers are named; no identifier is invented for the unlabeled Codex findings, and no observation identifier is invented. leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded is [], leftoverDesign remains [OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING], and the leftover-design of the four D-350 copies is remasured stale as an authoring claim in the successor's own words. Every one of the 32 named attacks was run and none landed. No MUST-FIX. No SHOULD-FIX.
